title: Reading your cards
intro: Every card shares the same layout. Hover or click a marker to read the explanation linked to the card.

unit.caption: Jackie Welles: Ride or Die Choom

cost.name: Cost
cost.body: Spend Eddies equal to a card’s cost to play it. (You can also spend face-up or face-down Legends as 1 €$ each.)

sell.name: Sell tag
sell.body: You can sell cards with this symbol for Eddies. Legends with a sell tag can be spent to pay 1 €$ in the Legends area.

type.name: Type
type.body: Designates a card as a Legend, Unit, Program, or Gear.

ram.name: RAM
ram.body: Your Legends’ cumulative RAM amount & color determines the other cards that can be included in your deck.

art.name: Artwork
art.body: The card art. The frame color matches the RAM color.

name.name: Name
name.body: Card name, sometimes with a subtitle. Up to 3 copies of the same card; your 3 Legends must have unique names.

classes.name: Tags
classes.body: Designates a card’s affiliations. These can be referenced in effects.

keyword.name: Keyword
keyword.body: A standard effect (Go Solo, Adrenaline, Quick, Blocker). Reminder text often follows in parentheses.

text.name: Effect text
text.body: What the card does. Timing triggers (Play, Call, Attack, Defeated) tell you when the effect happens. If card text conflicts with the rules, follow the card.

power.name: Power
power.body: Used in attacking. Determines success in fights against rival Units. A Unit steals two Gigs at 10 power, three at 20, and so on.

set.name: Set & number
set.body: Expansion code (MS01 – WNC) and collector number, handy to find the card in the catalog.

illustrator.name: Artist credit
illustrator.body: The illustrator’s name, printed along the card edge.

legendOverrides.cost: On a Legend, this is what you pay to play it as a Unit with Go Solo. Otherwise the Legend stays in its area and can pay 1 €$.
legendOverrides.ram: On a Legend, this is the RAM it grants your deck. Add up your 3 Legends’ RAM per color to get your deck-building limits.
legendOverrides.power: Power used if the Legend enters the Field with Go Solo.
